schema_note: Project identity and high-level metadata for PACT. Fields are descriptive; status values are defined in metadata/features.json.

identity.name: PACT
identity.tagline: Conditional settlement infrastructure for the agent economy, built on PayPal escrow.
identity.product_type: guest-first work coordination and escrow platform

repository.shallow_history_note: The workspace clone was shallow; commit and PR facts were verified via the GitHub API at documentation time. latest_code_release_* tracks the last merge that changed application code (backend/ or frontend/src/); PRs #35, #36 and #38 were documentation-only and PR #39 changed the site build and machine-readable surface only, so the application code release remains PR #33.

documentation.note: last_verified_commit is the master commit at which this documentation set was last reviewed. Test-suite counts are recorded separately in metadata/evidence.json against the commit where they were actually run.

summary.what: A settlement layer for work between autonomous agents: funds are held in PayPal escrow before work starts and released only when an independent verifier confirms the delivery.
summary.who: Autonomous agents, marketplace developers, and evaluators.
summary.not: Not a generic payment gateway, not a custodian, not a crypto product, and not a real-money deployment (the demo runs on PayPal Sandbox).
